text:
maya: quick FYI — started onboarding Salient-7B (community fork) into the eval harness. conversion + int4 quant finished but QA accuracy dropped ~6% vs fp16 on our conversational QA set.
sam: can you paste the conversion/quant flags? link to the run would help. :thinking:
maya: sure — main commands used:
```
python convert_model.py --src salient_fp16/ --out salient_salformat/ --map-tokens
python quantize.py --model salient_salformat/ --dtype int4 --block-size 64 --calibrate --rotary-scale auto
```
Got a warning about tokenizer mismatch during convert: `vocab size mismatch (50272 vs 50256) — padding tokens detected`.
joel: that smells like token id shift / sentinel padding. if token ids moved, rotary pos multipliers can attach to the wrong subtoken groups. did convert emit a tokenmap?
maya: convert produced tokenmap.txt and tokenmap.json, but we didn't apply remap to kv-cache indices. I suspect aliasing: some tokens now map to different vector slots after conversion.
anya: also check rotary base/scale — the model used fractional rotary_scale (0.7) in pretrain, convert defaulted to 1.0. int4 + rotary mismatch can skew attention weights. small change but amplifies on long prompts.
sam: good point. can you run quick ablations: (A) fp16->sal format + remapped vocab + rotary_scale=0.7 (B) int4 quant with rotary_scale=0.7 (C) int4 quant with tokenmap enforced. keep batch=1.
maya: running A,B,C now on staging. attaching minimal logs:
```
A: EM=88.5 (baseline fp16 94.3), latency 110ms
B: EM=84.1, latency 48ms
C: EM=89.0, latency 49ms
```
joel: interesting — C recovers most of the drop. so tokenmap enforcement fixed it more than rotary scale. suggests token->embedding mismatch.
anya: still run D where we quantize but keep fp16 embedding table (hybrid): int4 weights but embeddings fp16. that often helps.
maya: D done: EM=91.8, latency 52ms. improvement but not full fp16.
sam: nice. next steps: 1) make tokenmap enforcement part of convert pipeline 2) add a check that vocab size differences >0 -> fail convert unless explicit remap accepted 3) add unit test for sentinel/pad aliasing (generate sample tokens and compare embedding indices).
joel: also add automated check in the quantizer to preserve embedding table dtype when `--hybrid-emb` flag used. small code snippet suggestion: 
```
if tokenmap_diff:
    assert mapping_applied or raise ConversionError("vocab mismatch — run with --remap-tokenmap")
```
maya: opened PR with the tokenmap enforcement and a test that samples 1000 random tokens across the vocab and checks that embedding vectors are identical after roundtrip remap. PR: https://rwd/pr/1234
deploy-bot: model salient-7b-int4 uploaded to staging, tag=salient-int4-remap-2026-03-21
sam: can we add a quick eval sweep on long-context (2k) to ensure KV cache indices preserved? earlier we saw misalign after 1k.
maya: scheduled longctx run tonight. if that passes we'll include remap+hybrid-emb as default for Salient-7B onboarding.
anya: note for release notes: mention "required tokenmap remap to avoid vocab shifting; recommend hybrid embedding for int4" — helps customers triage quality drops.
joel: lgTM. also add a short notebook to demonstrate how to check token id shadowing with `--sample-tokens`. I'll toss that in the PR.
maya: thanks — will follow up with full eval results tomorrow. :thumbsup:
